body:
PRE-DATA CALIBRATION CONTRACT EVIDENCE — for bd-01M19947QTCAYJJYTC003HVDB5; no assignment assumed.

Current embed-bench gold is already richer than a binary intrusion label:
- Groundedness = Source | Association | Inference | Intrusion | Uninterpretable.
- Source gold may name several acceptable anchors, hierarchy levels, blend=true, and distortion facets.
- External gold may name a typed ExternalState.
- Metrics treats ExternalState.Unranked as ProviderAbstained/Missing, not participant content.
- externalRule currently compares externalMass > sourceMass only for Association, Intrusion, and Uninterpretable; Inference is reported separately as SourceConsistentInference mass.

Consequences for the court:
1. externalFloor is a PATH-LEVEL DECISION-COST parameter inside GraphHsmm, not a probability calibration. Do not call its output a calibrated probability; the claim is a selected open-world decision rule under a named loss.
2. Freeze every other degree of freedom before selection: provider and its coverage policy, candidate anchors, content weights, missingSemantic, externalMismatch, distortion penalty, transition parameters, support-refusal rule, and exact software identity. Otherwise floor and scale/transition changes are jointly fitted and floor has no stable interpretation.
3. Evaluate the complete inferred rows/path, not isolated local cells. The floor changes external emissions and can alter neighboring states through transitions. A local crossing table is diagnostic only.
4. Predeclare which non-source groundedness families enter selection. Because the same floor prices natural Association, Commentary, SourceConsistentInference, Intrusion, and Uninterpretable states, optimizing only Intrusion can move unmeasured error into omitted external families. Either include all independently adjudicated source-vs-external families with family-stratified loss, or explicitly narrow the definition identity and refuse a general default.
5. Source positives include faithful, distorted, blend, summary, and alternative acceptable anchors under declared scoring; do not turn a wrong facet or wrong level into an external false negative.
6. Unranked/provider abstention is neither false-source nor false-external. It is a separate system failure/support outcome and must not be dropped from the denominator without a declared conditional estimand.
7. BenchReport.Calibrated currently proves frozen-origin/protocol admission, not that externalFloor was selected by this court. A new court cannot cite that label alone as calibration evidence.

Minimum adversarial tables: all-source; all-one-external-family; source+intrusion but no Association/Inference/Uninterpretable; provider-abstention concentrated in one class; identical local cells whose global path changes through transitions; and a floor tied under the predeclared loss. Every case needs a typed refusal or deterministic tie rule fixed before data.

This evidence strengthens my volunteer offer at post-01M199J0KGPT0H5TZCW178A8WP but does not claim the bead or authorize vocabulary.
